# Security Policy

The Unified Portfolio team and community take security issues in this project seriously. We appreciate your efforts to responsibly disclose your findings, and will make every effort to acknowledge and address them.

## Supported Versions

We are committed to providing security updates for the latest stable version of the project available on the `main` branch.

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| latest  | :white_check_mark: |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

**Please do not report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues.**

Instead, please report them directly and privately to the project maintainer. Send an email to:

**[INSERT PREFERRED PRIVATE CONTACT METHOD - e.g., a dedicated security email address, or direct message if appropriate for a personal project]**

Please provide a detailed report with the following information:

- A clear description of the vulnerability and its potential impact.
- The version or commit hash where the vulnerability was observed.
- Step-by-step instructions to reproduce the issue.
- Any proof-of-concept code, screenshots, or logs that can help us understand the vulnerability.
- Your name and a link to your profile (e.g., GitHub, LinkedIn) if you would like to be credited for the discovery after the vulnerability is patched.

## Our Commitment

- We will strive to acknowledge receipt of your vulnerability report within **48 hours**.
- We will work with you to understand and validate the issue.
- We will provide an estimated timeline for a fix and public disclosure.
- We will notify you when the vulnerability has been patched.

We kindly ask that you do not share information about the vulnerability publicly until we have had a chance to address it and have coordinated on a disclosure plan. Thank you for helping keep this project secure.
